text: {"name":"rf_build_cal_block_v2","confidence":"high","docstring":"Pack a six-byte RF calibration block by writing a constant 0x03/0x02 header, encoding a source byte at bits 12-15 with bit 11 controlled by another source flag, and storing a 16-bit payload at offset 4.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"a1":"dest_block","a2":"cal_entry","a3":"payload_u16","v3":"cal_code","v4":"cal_enable","v5":"encoded_control"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"dest_block header byte, always set to 3"},{"offset":1,"meaning":"dest_block header byte, always set to 2"},{"offset":2,"meaning":"dest_block control word: cal_entry byte 22 shifted left by 12, with bit 11 set if cal_entry byte 17 equals 1"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"dest_block payload word copied from a3"},{"offset":17,"meaning":"cal_entry flag byte: enables bit 11 of the encoded control word when equal to 1"},{"offset":22,"meaning":"cal_entry code/index byte shifted into bits 12-15 of the encoded control word"}]}
